body: The Metal changes all look good!

Tested locally (rebased on top of `master` https://github.com/godotengine/godot/commit/9e6ee9c5c3c2037187e7b9a84b41a4119fb6b625), it works as expected.

## Benchmark

<details open>

<summary>PC specifications</summary>

- **CPU:** Intel Core i9-13900K
- **GPU:** NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090
- **RAM:** 64 GB (2×32 GB DDR5-5800 C30)
- **SSD:** Solidigm P44 Pro 2 TB
- **OS:** Linux (Fedora 41)
</details>

TPS Demo performance is bad, due to the comment I noted

Looks great to me! No significant change to performance was observed running some tests.

I compared a CI build from this branch to verify Metal CPU performance hadn't changed with the use of slot-binding (hence the 64x64 window).

Running the godot-reflection benchmark:

```sh
--screen 1 --disable-vsync --print-fps --resolution 64x64 -- --benchmark
```
